purpose: Teach: 磁気/健在/ピット/地雷/風車/衣類/ふれあい/エキス

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、磁気のおもちゃ集めてたろ?
lines.en: Hey, weren't you collecting those magnetic toys?
lines.style: Teasing, light accusation. Casual lob across the conversation. Warm underneath the needling—she's comfortable with him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のお祖父さん、ご健在?桜
lines.en: Is your grandpa still doing okay, Sakura?
lines.style: Genuine inquiry with slight awkwardness underneath. Soft on her name—checking in on something that might matter. Small, honest pause before speaking.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、レースのピット見学したろ?
lines.en: Didn't you get to tour the racing pit crew?
lines.style: Bright challenge. Fishing for confirmation. The tone of someone who overheard something cool and wants him to confirm it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会の授業で地雷問題やったろ?桜
lines.en: You covered landmine issues in social studies, right, Sakura?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact question delivered with slight hesitation. Not performative—genuine interest in what she's learning. His name for her sits warm at the end.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会で風車のエネルギーやったろ?
lines.en: Wait, you actually studied windmill energy in class?
lines.style: Surprised follow-up. Genuine caught-off-guard note. Quick pace, like the thought just hit him. Leans into the specificity of it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、衣類リサイクルに興味あんだろ?桜
lines.en: You're into clothing recycling, aren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Observant statement dressed as question. Not accusatory—noticing something real about her. Slight smile underneath. His tone says he's paid attention.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ふれあい交流会出たろ?
lines.en: Did you end up going to that exchange meet?
lines.style: Casual check-in. Light, no pressure. The kind of question someone asks when they half-know the answer and just want to hear what happened.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、健康ドリンクのエキス飲んでんな、桜
lines.en: You're really into those health drink supplements now, aren't you.
lines.style: Dry, half-amused. Slight edge of gentle mockery—caught her in something small and harmless. Familiar, unbothered, affectionate underneath.
